description: THREAT-EV-HOLD. Round 1 Custodes mirror, P1 Movement, both seats HUMAN. Prosecutors (45pt, 4 wounds) are the sole holder of obj_home_1 and P2's Allarus Custodians is staged 3" away. Setup: P1's profile sets THREAT_TARGET_SPLIT=0 (each unit assumes the enemy charges it) so the holder's survival chance is ~1% — the regime the release targets. The forced hold gives way to the scores: the Prosecutors' card shows its hold option carrying 'Likely dead before it scores' / 'Unit at risk' and the AI no longer plans 'hold obj_home_1' for it.

steps.comment: stage P2 Allarus centroid at Vector2(950, 560)
swap Prosecutors onto obj_home_1 (Custodian Guard Zeta moved off); test profile: THREAT_TARGET_SPLIT=0

steps.script: main._ai_suggestion_panel.full_text.contains("MOVEMENT · Prosecutors") and main._ai_suggestion_panel.full_text.contains("Hold obj_home_1") and main._ai_suggestion_panel.full_text.contains("Unit at risk")
